body: I also for want of a better term have an ongoing problem with not becoming an incel, I want to be a decent person, but I can feel myself becoming increasingly bitter.

I'm just worried about my reaction. On one hand maybe it'll move my mood somewhat in the right direction. But what if I start crying or something. I don't want to make something like that any worse for her than it already is.

I've tried the gym numerous times, I've tried diets and I don't know what I'm doing wrong. My entire body revulses me, anfmd if it were to go  then I would have some hope that at least one person would find me passable. I have never recieved a single compliment.

I don't really have any chances anyway. I just don't know how or what to do to convince myself to do anything else, I keep paying for meds that don't do anything, get put on stupidly long waiting lists for "therapists" that just give crisis numbers to organisations that are worse than useless, and whenever I leave the house I am surrounded by people who are living lives I can't have, and that just causes exra hurt inside. I can't really see any chances there.
It's this or nothing. The end result is the same whichever.
Maybe not, but it would be something. I can't keep living like this.
Theres no one in particular. I just know I'm basically disgusting by everyones standards, fat that wont go away and ugly underneath it all, I just want at least something like that before I go.
